name: April
title: Where to go on holiday in April
intro: Spring arrives across Europe in April, with cities like Rome, Paris and Lisbon before the summer crowds. It's also a good month for Japan, Jordan and the Caribbean.
seo_title: Where is hot in April? Easter sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
April is when Europe wakes up. Southern Spain, Morocco, Cyprus and Greece reach the low to mid twenties, and the big cities, Rome, Florence, Lisbon and Paris, are at their most pleasant before the summer crowds. It's warm enough to eat outside in most of the Mediterranean, but the sea is still cool, around 16 to 18°C, so it isn't yet a swimming month.

For guaranteed beach heat you still need a long-haul flight, and April is a good month for it: the Caribbean is dry, and Bali, the Maldives and Vietnam are coming into their best season.

Easter usually falls in April (in 2027 it's early, on 28 March), and the school holidays push up prices for a fortnight. The temperatures below are average daytime highs for April, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in April is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest places within about six hours of the UK:

- **1. Luxor and the [Nile](/destinations/nile-cruise):** around 35°C, already hot. About 5 hours.
- **2. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) and [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** around 25°C. 3 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours.
- **3. [Seville](/destinations/seville):** around 24°C, and the city's April fair. About 2 hours 30 minutes.
- **4. [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** around 23 to 24°C. About 4 hours.
- **5. [Jordan](/destinations/jordan):** around 23°C, perfect for Petra and Wadi Rum. About 5 hours.
- **6. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), [Paphos](/destinations/paphos) and [Antalya](/destinations/antalya):** around 22°C. 2 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **7. [Athens](/destinations/athens), [Valencia](/destinations/valencia), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes):** around 21°C. 2 to 4 hours.
- **8. [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon), [Malta](/destinations/malta), [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) and [Florence](/destinations/florence):** around 20°C. 2 to 4 hours.

sections.heading: Spring sun under five hours
sections.text:
If you want warmth without a long flight, April gives you more choice than any month since October.

- **Southern Spain:** [Seville](/destinations/seville) is around 24°C and holds its Feria de Abril, usually a couple of weeks after Easter. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Cádiz](/destinations/cadiz) are warm enough for lunch on the beach, if not a swim.
- **Morocco:** [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) is around 25°C, one of its best months, and the [desert road trip](/destinations/morocco-desert-road-trip) is still comfortable.
- **Cyprus and Turkey:** [Paphos](/destinations/paphos) and [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) are around 22°C, with wildflowers on the hills.
- **The Canaries:** still the most reliable sunshine, around 23 to 24°C, but Easter is one of their busiest weeks.

The Greek islands are starting to open for the season, but many hotels and tavernas on smaller islands don't open until May.

sections.heading: City breaks at their best
sections.text:
April is one of the best months of the year for a European city break. It's warm enough to walk all day, the parks are in flower, and outside Easter the queues are shorter than in summer.

- **Italy:** [Rome](/destinations/rome), [Florence](/destinations/florence) and [Venice](/destinations/venice) are around 17 to 20°C. Book the Vatican and the Uffizi ahead at Easter.
- **Spain and Portugal:** [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon), [Porto](/destinations/porto), [Madrid](/destinations/madrid) and [Valencia](/destinations/valencia) are around 18 to 21°C.
- **Further north:** [Paris](/destinations/paris) is around 16°C, and [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) is at its busiest for the tulips, which usually peak in mid to late April.
- **Something different:** [Athens](/destinations/athens) is around 21°C, before the summer heat makes the Acropolis hard work.

See our [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page for more.

sections.heading: Long-haul in April
sections.text:
- **The Caribbean:** [Barbados](/destinations/barbados), [St Lucia](/destinations/st-lucia), [Antigua](/destinations/antigua) and [Grenada](/destinations/grenada) are around 29 to 30°C and still dry. After Easter, prices start to fall.
- **Mexico:** [Cancún](/destinations/cancun) is around 31°C, and [Mexico City](/destinations/mexico-city) is warm and dry.
- **Asia:** [Bali](/destinations/bali) is coming into its dry season, the [Maldives](/destinations/maldives) are hot and calm, and [Hoi An](/destinations/hoi-an) and [Ha Long Bay](/destinations/ha-long-bay) are at their best before the summer heat.
- **Florida:** [Orlando](/destinations/orlando) and [Miami](/destinations/miami) are around 28°C, warm without the summer storms, though Easter is a peak week for the parks.
- **Japan:** early April is usually the tail end of the cherry blossom in [Tokyo](/destinations/tokyo) and Kyoto, and it moves north through the month.

sections.heading: Easter holidays
sections.text:
Easter is the busiest and most expensive fortnight of the spring. If your dates are fixed, book early, especially for the Canaries, the ski resorts and Florida. If they aren't, the week after the school holidays usually brings the same weather for much less. In 2027, Easter Sunday is on 28 March, so the school holidays straddle the end of March and the start of April.

Skiing is still good at high altitude when Easter is early: [Val Thorens](/destinations/val-thorens) is one of the most snow-sure resorts in the Alps. Our [Easter holidays](/destinations/easter-holidays) page has the full list.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
For a short flight and warm days, Seville, Marrakech and the Canaries are the safest bets. For a city break, April is close to perfect almost anywhere in southern Europe. For a beach you can actually swim from, go long-haul to the Caribbean, Mexico or the Maldives.

If you're choosing as a family or group and everyone wants something different, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is warm for Easter?
faqs.answer: Malta, Cyprus (Paphos), Madeira, Cape Verde and Marrakech are all warm enough for T-shirts. Further away, Mauritius, Barbados and Mexico are in their dry season.

faqs.question: Is April a good time for a city break?
faqs.answer: It's one of the best. Rome, Paris, Lisbon, Porto, Valencia, Amsterdam and New York are pleasantly warm, the queues are shorter than in summer, and the days are long enough for a lot of walking.

faqs.question: Is April good for Japan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The start of April is often still cherry blossom season in Tokyo, and it's lovely in Kanazawa too. Avoid the last few days of April into early May, which is Golden Week, when Japan itself goes on holiday.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in April?
faqs.answer: Seville and the Canary Islands, both around 23 to 24°C. Just outside Europe, Marrakech is around 25°C and Luxor in Egypt is already around 35°C.

faqs.question: Is it warm enough to swim in the sea in April?
faqs.answer: Not really in Europe. The Mediterranean is around 16 to 18°C and the Canaries around 18 to 19°C. For warm sea, go long-haul to the Caribbean, Mexico or the Maldives.

faqs.question: Is Greece warm in April?
faqs.answer: Mild rather than hot. Athens and Rhodes are around 21°C, good for sightseeing, but the sea is cool and many smaller islands don't fully open until May.
